content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Streetlights turn off when I walk under them. It’s like they’re tracking me.
I can’t confirm tracking by streetlights. Many use sensors and timers. At how many locations has this happened, and what were the times?
Three blocks near my apartment, mostly late evening.
Testing at different times and on different blocks can show if it’s tied to specific fixtures or schedules.
It felt personal because it was right when I passed.
A travel companion filming from across the street could capture whether other passersby trigger the same behavior.
I can ask a neighbor to watch.
If lights switch similarly without your presence, that points to regular cycling or sensor quirks.
I’ll compare weekdays and weekends too.
